qwen3.8-27b-aq3.display_name: AryaInfer Qwen3.8 27B GSQ3 AQ3 - 128K vision (Arya engine, faster writing)
qwen3.8-27b-aq3.notes: ISTA-DASLab's 3-bit GSQ checkpoint repacked as AQ3 (tools/aryainfer_gsq3_convert.py), uniform 3-bit with a scale per 128, read only by aryainfer.exe. Measured on this host 2026-11-03, final build: reading 1,444-1,633 tok/s at 8K (batch 2,048; 1,266 at batch 512, 711 before the Q8_0 expansion was made coalesced) and 1,153.9-1,175.0 on a 62K prompt (batch 2,048, 64K context; 990 before the attention work); 968.7 on a 61,787-token prompt through the server at 131K context (15.2 GiB, before that work); writing 88-104 tok/s at 8K. The prompt attention keeps its scores as halves and uses bigger key blocks, taking its share of 62K prefill from 39% (24.4 s) to 35% (18.8 s). Entry paths repaired 2026-11-03 (they held UNC paths that do not resolve) and the vision encoder points at the AQ3 file; an image turn was checked. Batch 1024 is its setting: 2048 at 131K would add ~1.4 GiB on a card that measured 15.2 GiB.
